answer: PoA resists Sybil identities by requiring each claimant to complete a VDF’s sequential modular squarings before admission; each result depends on the previous one, so GPUs cannot shorten that identity’s chain through parallel execution. An attacker may run separate chains concurrently, but every clone still incurs its own delay and work. The Wesolowski proof lets others verify completion efficiently, while inlet, whisper, and basalt serve only as harmless labels, not shortcuts.
